title: Anticancer Effect of Polyphyllin I in Suppressing Stem Cell-Like Properties of Hepatocellular Carcinoma via the AKT/GSK-3beta/beta-Catenin Signaling Pathway.
authors: Liao, Mianmian; Du, Haiyan; Wang, Bing; Huang, Jinzhen; Huang, Danping; Tong, Guangdong
one_liner_zh: 研究皂苷PPI通过AKT/GSK-3β/β-catenin通路抑制肝癌干细胞特性，仅用分子对接评估小分子-蛋白亲和力，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Polyphyllin I (PPI), also called Chong Lou saponin I, is a steroidal saponin isolated from the rhizome of Paris polyphylla. PPI has been demonstrated to have strong anticancer activity. However, its effect on the stemness of liver cancer stem cells (LCSCs) is not completely understood. Herein, we aimed to investigate the effect of PPI on the stem cell-like features of LCSCs and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). LCSCs were enriched in a serum-free medium and treated with PPI, sorafenib (Sora), or PPI and Sora. Several endpoints, including spheroid formation and differentiation, cell proliferation, surface markers of LCSCs, PPI binding targets, and stemness-associated protein expression, were evaluated. Immunofluorescence staining, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, siRNA transfection, and coimmunoprecipitation ubiquitination assays were conducted for in-depth mechanistic studies. Evaluation of in vivo antitumor efficacy demonstrated that PPI effectively inhibited the proliferation of liver cancer cells and the self-renewal and differentiation of LCSCs. Flow cytometry indicated that PPI suppressed the expression of the stem cell surface markers EpCAM and CD13. Molecular docking showed a high affinity between PPI and proteins of the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway, including AKT, GSK-3beta, and beta-catenin, with the binding energies of -5.51, -5.32, and -5.40 kcal/mol, respectively, which suggested that PPI might regulate the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway to affect the stem cell-like properties of HCC. Further ex vivo experiments implied that PPI activated the AKT/GSK-3beta-mediated ubiquitin proteasomal degradation of beta-catenin and subsequently attenuated the prooncogenic effect of LCSCs. Finally, the anticancer property of PPI was confirmed in vivo. It was found that PPI inhibited the tumor growth in an HCC cell line xenograft model. Taken together, molecular docking analysis and experimental data highlighted the novel function of PPI in suppressing the stem cell-like characteristics of LCSCs via the AKT/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 重楼皂苷I（Polyphyllin I, PPI），又称重楼皂苷I，是从重楼（Paris polyphylla）根茎中分离得到的一种甾体皂苷。已有研究表明，PPI具有强效的抗癌活性。然而，其对肝癌干细胞（liver cancer stem cells, LCSCs）干性的影响尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在探讨PPI对LCSCs及肝细胞癌（hepatocellular carcinoma, HCC）干细胞样特征的影响。通过无血清培养基富集LCSCs，并分别用PPI、索拉非尼（sorafenib, Sora）或PPI联合Sora处理。评估了多个终点指标，包括球体形成与分化、细胞增殖、LCSCs表面标志物、PPI结合靶点及干性相关蛋白表达。为深入机制研究，进行了免疫荧光染色、实时定量聚合酶链反应、siRNA转染及免疫共沉淀泛素化实验。体内抗肿瘤疗效评估显示，PPI有效抑制肝癌细胞增殖及LCSCs的自我更新和分化。流式细胞术表明，PPI抑制干细胞表面标志物EpCAM和CD13的表达。分子对接显示，PPI与Wnt/β-catenin信号通路蛋白（包括AKT、GSK-3β和β-catenin）具有高亲和力，结合能分别为-5.51、-5.32和-5.40 kcal/mol，提示PPI可能通过调控Wnt/β-catenin信号通路影响HCC的干细胞样特性。进一步的离体实验表明，PPI激活AKT/GSK-3β介导的β-catenin泛素-蛋白酶体降解，随后减弱LCSCs的促癌作用。最后，在体内实验中证实了PPI的抗癌特性，发现PPI在HCC细胞系异种移植模型中抑制肿瘤生长。综上所述，分子对接分析和实验数据突出了PPI通过AKT/GSK-3β/β-catenin信号通路抑制LCSCs干细胞样特征的新功能。
